europe_now.title: Major Russian grain export terminals hit in Ukraine Black Sea port attack
europe_now.summary: Russian attacks damaged major grain export terminals in Ukraine's Black Sea port, disrupting grain shipments.

europe_now.title: Putin threatens to seize European ships
europe_now.summary: Russian President Vladimir Putin threatened to seize European ships, raising security concerns across the continent.

top_stories.title: Solar eclipse captivates Europe
top_stories.summary: A total solar eclipse swept across much of Europe on 12 August 2026, drawing large crowds and media attention. The event was observed from Spain, France, and other European countries, with partial phases visible in northern and western regions.

top_stories.title: Ceuta migration crisis
top_stories.summary: The Ceuta border crisis has intensified, with migrants attempting to cross into Spain from Morocco. The situation has sparked debate over EU solidarity and external relations, as families seek refuge.
